# NexusUtils Specification

Free offline-first utility sandbox for developers, design creators, programmatic SEO growth hackers, and tech managers. All capabilities are completed fully in temporary sandboxed RAM matrices.

## Core Capabilities
- **Smart client-side PDF Hub & Inspector**: orientation configuration, margins management, and file parameters metadata checks.
- **JSON Formatter & Validator**: Beautifies, parses, and identifies syntax errors on structural trees.
- **High-Performance QR Code Generator**: Generates SVG tags, colors padding, and exports PNG design assets.
- **Word Counter & Frequency Analyzer**: Tracks word lengths, content reading levels, sentence lengths, and SEO density vectors.
- **Secure Password Strength Meter**: Inspects entropy levels and generates strong cryptographic passwords offline.
- **Hash Converter**: Real-time MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 transformations with high-entropy validation checks.
- **UTM Tag Builder**: Easily outputs compliant campaign URLs.
- **User-Agent Parser**: Inspects browser client features.
